This limitation hinders the development of MLLMs for cognitively demanding RS applications. item.title: Behavioral Integrity Verification for AI Agent Skills
item.description: Agent skills extend LLM agents with privileged third-party capabilities such as filesystem access, credentials, network calls, and shell execution. Existing safety work catches malicious prompts and risky runtime actions, but the skill artifact itself goes unverified. item.title: DatalogBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Text-to-Datalog Synthesis
item.description: Datalog underpins reasoning tasks such as program analysis, but its programs are hard to write.
